instruction: Sign GOOD once naturally using the same two-hand AppHear target form.
Sign KNOW once naturally: one hand to the temple, then return to rest.
Sign SISTER once naturally using the AppHear target form.
Sign WE once naturally using the one-hand AppHear path across the upper torso.
Sign MOVE once naturally using the AppHear target form.
Sign WHO once naturally using the same AppHear target form tested in RU-D2.
Sign HAVE once naturally with both hands visible.
Sign COME once naturally using the two-hand inward-to-torso AppHear target form.
Sign KEEP once naturally using the AppHear target form.
Sign LEAVE once naturally using the intended two-hand open-close-withdraw form.
Sign HELLO once naturally using the AppHear target form.
Sign PUT once naturally using the AppHear target form you previously used.
Sign NOW once naturally using the AppHear target form.
Repeat one natural WHO attempt after returning fully to rest.
Repeat one natural PUT attempt using the same AppHear form as R1.
Repeat one natural KNOW temple-form attempt after returning fully to rest.
Repeat one natural two-hand GOOD attempt.
Repeat one natural two-hand COME inward-to-torso attempt.
Repeat one natural SISTER attempt using the same form as R1.
Repeat one natural two-hand LEAVE attempt.
Repeat one natural HAVE attempt with both hands visible.
Repeat one natural one-hand WE path attempt.
Repeat one natural KEEP attempt using the same form as R1.
Repeat one natural NOW attempt.
Repeat one natural MOVE attempt using the same form as R1.
Repeat one natural HELLO attempt.
